rules.statement: Where a foreign operator must designate a domestic representative, state the representative's name (for a corporation, its name and the CEO's name), address (for a corporation, business office), phone number and e-mail.
rules.effectiveNote: Act 20897 (promulgated 2025-04-01, in force 2025-10-02): representative's name, address, phone and e-mail must be in the policy; Decree 35780 same date.

rules.statement: The phone must be reachable in Korea (need not be a personal mobile) and must actually handle privacy complaints and consultations.

Where the operator has a Korean corporation it set up or controls (appoints the CEO or 50%+ of officers, or holds 30%+ of shares), the representative is chosen from those corporations. Context for C1; the policy states only the chosen representative.
rules.effectiveNote: Affiliate-selection duty introduced by Act 20897 (in force 2025-10-02).

designationCriteria.note: Applicability context from the guideline (PIPA 31-2, Decree 32-3); C1 uses it to question gate.domesticRepRequired.
criteria: prior-year total revenue of KRW 1 trillion or more
daily average of 1 million or more Korean data subjects stored in the 3 months before prior year-end
required by PIPC after a materials request under PIPA 63(1)

goodPatterns: Lead: data subjects may contact the representative designated under PIPA 31-2 for complaint handling; block with name (corporate name and CEO), address (office), phone, e-mail.

commonDefects.defect: Foreign operator meeting the criteria omits representative or one of the four contact fields.
Phone given is overseas-only or a sales line.

extractionHints: "한국 지사 없음", "본사가 해외", global revenue, Korean DAU

needsVerification.note: Guideline and spike both mention a fine of up to KRW 10 million for omission; fine levels are not policy content and are not used in rules.
Decree 35780 (2025-10-02) changed designation criteria; confirm the thresholds above still match before C1 uses them as hard gates.
